companies_account_uq.name: companies_account_uq
companies_account_uq.where: dissolved_at IS NULL AND account_id IS NOT NULL

holdings_qty_ok.name: holdings_qty_ok
holdings_qty_ok.value: qty_kg >= 0 AND reserved_kg >= 0 AND reserved_kg <= qty_kg AND cost_total >= 0

ledger_cash_nonneg.name: ledger_cash_nonneg
ledger_cash_nonneg.value: company_id IS NULL OR code <> 'cash' OR balance >= 0

orders_remaining_ok.name: orders_remaining_ok
orders_remaining_ok.value: remaining_kg >= 0 AND remaining_kg <= qty_kg AND escrow_remaining >= 0
